currentDirection.name: One blue. A whole experience.
currentDirection.agreement: Initial application rules reviewed by Brand Guardian, UI Designer and UX Architect; later client-directed composition correction implemented and consolidated without claiming a new panel consensus
currentDirection.componentStudy: development route /composition-study; historical standalone study at docs/brand/color-catalog/component-study.html
rules: Compose ground, text, actions and decorative detail independently; recurring blue links tonal fields, natural imagery, orange and magenta details, frames and inset planes
No fixed color percentages, one-accent-per-section restriction or exclusive section/department color ownership; preserve hierarchy and tested pairs
Blue leads; orange supports; magenta is occasional editorial expression without gender, condition, or specialty coding
Original logo artwork remains unchanged; yellow stays inside artwork
Ordinary links use strong blue on approved light surfaces; dark surfaces require inverse links
White fields use control edge; quiet edge is decorative
Use deep orange on pale orange for normal accent text; avoid normal white text on orange and primary-blue text on mist
Keep urgent and error aliases and wording separate despite their shared red primitive
Current Lato/FreeSerif/Ethiopic editorial presentation and task-specific responsive layouts are documented in the usage guide
Keep photographs naturally colored and evaluate scrims separately for legibility
currentDirection.boundary: Implemented in application tokens, homepage, shared components and reviewed local inner pages; usage guide finalized. Existing publication and content-readiness gates remain. Digital colors are not authenticated historical logo values
